operation: Independent skin needle series -> unrefitted geometry transfer -> first-pass versus repeat-pass work separation -> final response ports
data_plan: Reuse Shergold2005 human Fig20, friction-corrected 0.3mm train ->0.6mm heldout
Acquire Barnett2016 primary original/table with diameter, crack length, spreading and repeat/precut friction if accessible
Acquire independent porcine skin gauge/reuse series Owen2022 or tension/diameter series2021; no phantom curves labelled skin
primary_model: F=cD; c fixed from Shergold0.3mm friction-corrected pressure7.8MPa; a/R and negligible bulk are explicit closures; do not equate shank radius and cutting edge radius
within_series: One unused/sharp gauge anchor predicts other sharp gauges by diameter ratio without refit. Reuse/blunt points are adverse geometry/history tests, not same sharpness heldouts. If full cutting force+spreading+friction+crack length available, train Gamma on one gauge, predict others with measured geometry and independently measured spreading/friction; never per-case fit heldouts.
step_on_failure: Change observation from peak force/diameter to first-pass minus precut/repeat force integrated along insertion plus measured crack increment. Execute diagnostic work/geometry separation if primary ports acquired; otherwise execute identified versus unidentified force port contrast on independent source and preserve missing work fields.
control: Same-information F=cD conventional scaling: algorithm TIE
Published cohesive/fracture spreading+friction law with identical data is strongest comparator; no full FE claim when not executed
metrics: Absolute and relative error per heldout; mean-to-mean central tolerance20%; worst-case extraction uncertainty evaluated separately; reported SD/range never labelled confidence interval
falsifiers: Any prespecified sharp heldout central relative error>20% rejects common-c scaling over that scope
Peak minus friction does not identify propagation Gamma without recoverable bulk and crack-area data
No common posterior across species/site/age or blunting, unless independently measured
Gamma_cut_comparison: 150–380J/m2 is synthetic BINDINGS scenario, not measured cut estimate; effective force/diameter c and Gamma inferred with measured crack ratio are different quantities; chemical Gamma0 null unless independent precleavage work
ports: Tool-specific mechanical versus biological damage widths; missing values null; pierce/cut uncertainty and evidence scope; synchronized scalpel Ft/Fn/edge-radius/crack-area measurement specification

defaults.gauge_diameter: primary paper values preferred; manufacturer standard diameter only if marked nominal and separately sourced
defaults.uncertainty: source scatter and digitalization bounds separately; no invented statistical covariance
defaults.work_area: single projected crack plane convention; both surfaces counted only when stated
